mia: onboarding Helix-7B-int4 today. smoke runs look OK until ~140 tokens, then generation drifts vs fp16 baseline. logging here.

raj: can you paste the token ids around the drift and the model.json rotary metadata?

mia: token tail snippet: [1, 50256, 345, 789, 30522, 9, 3]
model.json shows: \"rotary_pack\": \"braid2\", \"rotary_dim\": 64, \"n_heads\": 16, \"vocab_shadow\": true

eli: braid2 often means a nonstandard head interleave. if loader assumes contiguous heads that will mis-index KV cache.

mia: quick repro script (very small):
```python
prompt = 'We evaluated the pipeline and found'
ids = tok.encode(prompt)
print(ids[-8:])
# run fp16 and int4, compare topk at step=140
```

raj: run `model-inspect --file helix.bin --dump-rotary-map` and paste output.

mia: inspector output: `rotary_map: [0,8,4,12,1,9,5,13,2,10,6,14,3,11,7,15]` and `vocab_shadow_table: {50256:30522}`

eli: that map is neither simple even-odd nor half-interleave. definitely a braid-like packing. the vocab shadow means sentinel ids were remapped into high slots. both can cause drift.

ci-bot: CI smoke helix-int4 job failed: ppl delta +0.2 at 03:12:05. https://ci.internal/runs/2710

raj: mitigation plan: 1) apply load-time head remap using rotary_map; 2) apply reverse vocab_shadow mapping at tokenization output so downstream sees canonical ids; 3) run small activation L2 check vs fp16 on first 8 tokens post-remap (threshold 1e-3); 4) add unit test asserting top-1 token equality for first 160 tokens.

mia: implementing remap now. patch will reshape q/k/v and reorder according to map, then recompute checksum. pushing WIP PR.

eli: add telemetry event for models where auto-remap applied so we can follow up with vendor. also include vendor export suggestion: canonical head-major layout + avoid vocab shadowing.

mia: will run smoke + ngram overlap eval after patch. ETA EOD. ping if CI still shows regressions. :white_check_mark:
